summary: FlowForge is a management and delivery platform designed for Node-RED applications. It provides DevOps tooling to help development teams deploy, scale, and secure their low-code automation flows.
goodFor: Teams using Node-RED for Internet of Things workloads who need centralised control over multiple development instances and production environments.
watchOut: The platform adds an extra operational layer on top of Node-RED, which may introduce unnecessary complexity for single-user or small-scale hobbyist deployments.
deployNotes: Because the stack relies on containers and orchestration runtimes, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for state and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
